exceptions.reason: get_X/set_X, list_imports/list_exports and X/Xs (decompile_function/decompile_functions) pairs are the conventional names; each description says which one to use when.
Only fires with GHIDRA_MCP_DISABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=1, which deliberately lists the whole catalog for clients that defer tools themselves. The default listing is ~22 tools.
Same as T001: only the opt-in full listing exceeds 25 tools.
rename_ and retype_decompiler_variable act on the same variable; each description names the other and says it changes only the name or only the type.
A GhidraScript is arbitrary code against a program that may have changed; replaying a stored result by id would be wrong. batch and execute carry operation_id.
Existing GhidraScripts cannot be confined to reads; execute(read_only=true) is the read-only route.
